The audience finds SOLOIST ahead of the rows, and the hand begins to rise as a deliberate act rather than incidental motion. CHORUS closes the authored distance without losing order. The ordered advance turns a readable pose into a cue with a recipient. The event leaves with the hand still raised and the rows at their authorized nearer endpoint, so the call has changed the shared ground but has not yet been held long enough to close the exchange.
